# «AgentOS» («AOS») — snapshot as of 2026-09-25 20:00 UTC
https://heyresearch.xyz/project/agentos

## Research summary (HEY's answer first; the sections below are its evidence)
- DERIVED Build: Shipping: 4 counted ships in 30 days; latest ship yesterday. Evidence: ship:2ac87a66-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.
- FACT Product usage: 4 of 4 watched contracts active · 1,842 calls in 7 days (532 calls to the contracts' own functions; 1,310 ERC-20 token transfers and approvals, which trading alone produces). Evidence: method:5b2d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.
- DERIVED Market: Liquidity no longer detected: HEY holds a valuation and does not publish it while the market is not live.
- UNKNOWN Not yet known: 3 gaps: Contract activity (not enough yet), Supply distribution (stale), Locks (no source). HEY has not read a day of the contract’s activity yet. [no_day_read]
  Each line has a detailUrl and, for its evidence ids, a receiptUrl on the snapshot; get_evidence id=<id> reads one.

## Identity
- DERIVED research level: verified builder; catalogue: verified builder; kind: utility; narrative: «AI Agents»
- FACT first recorded by HEY 2026-06-01 (HEY's knowledge time); listed by defillama 2022-10-19 (their date, not HEY's)
- FACT token: chain 4663, contract 0xcab100000000000000000000000000000000cb07

## Build
- DERIVED activity status: shipping; last meaningful ship 2026-09-24
- DERIVED Build Momentum 67.4 (hbm-v15)
- UNKNOWN Discovery Gap: not measured
- DERIVED build velocity: accelerating — 9 counted ships in 30 days against 4 before
- UNKNOWN release cadence: fewer than three release days
- DERIVED STILL BUILDING: down 62% from the HEY-tracked high, 5 counted ships since. Still Building = counted ships during a market drawdown HEY itself tracked. It is a record of what happened, not a prediction and not a buy signal. (stillBuildingState HELD)

## Market (context, never a ranking input)
- DERIVED token market: liquidity no longer detected (liquidity below floor). A reading of the market, not of the team.
- DERIVED valuation withheld: the market is not live (liquidity removed). HEY holds a figure and does not publish it.
- UNKNOWN liquidity: no reading.
- FACT promotion or takeover seen 3 times; newest: paid promotion (Enhanced token profile), 2026-09-26 (first seen by HEY). Context only: paid promotion never reaches a ranking, a score or a signal of building.
- Market in depth: https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/market

## Protocol economics (registry context, never building)
- FACT protocol economics: NOT_APPLICABLE (no_protocol_listing: matched to no DefiLlama protocol)

## Developer footprint (context, never a ship)
- FACT official repositories: 2; metadata read for 2 (MEASURED, repository_metadata_read)
- FACT newest production deployment 2026-09-20 (environment «Production», read 2026-09-26) — a dated record of an environment, not building
- FACT packages: MEASURED (none_found_in_package_index: the package index lists none for its official repositories — a reading of that index only, not "no package")
- FACT package advisories: NOT_APPLICABLE (no_accepted_package: no package confirmed as the project's own, so no advisory applies)
  Per dimension: https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/coverage

## Security context (evidence, never a verdict)
- UNKNOWN security context: HEY could not read it just now.

## On-chain
- UNKNOWN contract events: HEY could not index them (0 of 7 days readable); FACT 1204 calls in 24 h

## Usage (its own dimension, never building or a ranking)
- FACT 4 active of 4 watched contracts · 1,842 calls in 7 d (2026-09-19 to 2026-09-25); 1,310 of them the ERC-20 surface, 532 the contracts' own functions. ERC-20 transfers and approvals are what trading alone produces; by themselves they are not use of the product.
- FACT distinct caller addresses (a count per day; addresses, not people): newest day 212 or more on 2026-09-25; busiest day 312 or more on 2026-09-22. UNKNOWN across the window: counts for different days cannot be added.
- UNKNOWN events (events_unreadable_on_some_days)
- FACT method facts in the window: 1 first-ever call, 0 resumed after 30+ silent days (ids method:5b2d0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001).
- FACT most-called: erc20 standard 1,310, named 400 (function names stay on the Terminal).
  Usage says the contracts are used, not that anyone is building. Collection starts 2026-06-15; daily figures: https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/usage

## Peer context (one dimension at a time, never a score)
- UNKNOWN peer context: HEY could not read it just now.

## Token check, ownership and sources
- FACT token check: project names this contract (verification VERIFIED)
- FACT ownership: self-reported at submission; no owner has proved control
- FACT sources: 5 registered, 4 the project's own, 2 checked by HEY, 1 context only (not this project's evidence)
- DERIVED 9 counted ships in 30 days

## Locks and integrity
- UNKNOWN locks: NO_SOURCE (hoodlock_only_none_found) — HoodLock only; other lockers are not read, so this is not "no lock".
- UNKNOWN market integrity: WITHHELD (Market Integrity is not published on public surfaces yet.)

## Latest changes
- EXACT 2026-09-24 10:00 UTC · build.release: «Released v0.4» (event ship:2ac87a66-0000-0000-0000-000000000001; evidence ship:2ac87a66-0000-0000-0000-000000000001)
- WEEK week of 2026-09-14 · build.code_activity: 42 commits by 3 contributors (event ship:2ac87a66-0000-0000-0000-000000000002; no evidence id to open)
  Open an evidence id with get_evidence id=<evidence id>; an event id is not one. More: get_changes with project=agentos, or https://heyresearch.xyz/api/changes?project=agentos

## Freshness
- FACT Code activity: last read 2026-09-25 12:00 UTC (fresh; stale after 48 h)
- UNKNOWN HoodLock: HEY has never read it

## What HEY does not know
- UNKNOWN: current market (WITHHELD), contract activity (NOT_ENOUGH_YET), supply distribution (STALE), locks (NO_SOURCE), market integrity (WITHHELD), API description (NO_SOURCE), official source changes (NOT_ENOUGH_YET). Do not read these as zero or as "none".
  Per dimension: research_answer with capability unknowns and project=agentos, or https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/coverage

Links: detail https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos · timeline https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/timeline · changes https://heyresearch.xyz/api/changes?project=agentos · coverage https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/coverage · explain https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/explain · contracts https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/contracts · market https://heyresearch.xyz/api/projects/agentos/market
Tags: FACT = a value HEY recorded, with its source; DERIVED = a rule HEY applied to recorded values; UNKNOWN = HEY does not hold it (never a zero).
